intro: Armenian media cover political tensions around a new draft constitution and opposition demands, alongside economic updates on GDP growth and creative sector expansion. International developments include diplomatic appointments and regional security discussions.

topics.title: Draft constitution publication and referendum debate
topics.text: Armenia is set to publish a draft new constitution on November 23, according to multiple sources. Prime Minister Pashinyan has suggested the parliamentary opposition secure six votes to hold a referendum on the document, while opposition leaders have rejected his resignation offer and vowed to remove him regardless.

topics.title: Armenia's GDP growth and creative economy expansion
topics.text: Armenia's GDP reached 3.38 trillion drams in the third quarter, representing a 5.8% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The number of creative economy businesses has nearly doubled over three years, with the first statistical bulletin on the sector now published.

topics.title: New ambassadorial appointments to Russia and Poland
topics.text: Samvel Mkrtchyan has been appointed as Armenia's new ambassador to Russia, while Vahan Hunanyan has been named ambassador to Poland. The appointments come as Russia's MFA spokesperson confirmed neither Armenia nor Azerbaijan have recalled their signatures under the 2020 ceasefire statement.

topics.title: Capitol Hill hearing highlights Turkish-Azerbaijani threat to Armenia
topics.text: A Capitol Hill hearing has raised alarm over what participants describe as an existential threat to Armenia from Turkey and Azerbaijan. The session was covered by multiple Armenian diaspora outlets, emphasizing concerns over regional security and the rights of Artsakh Armenians.

topics.title: Armenia receives Palestinian children from Gaza for medical care
topics.text: Armenia has received three Palestinian children from Gaza for urgently needed specialist medical care. The humanitarian gesture was announced by the Foreign Ministry and reflects Armenia's engagement in international medical assistance.

topics.title: EAEU customs meeting hosted in Armenia and AI hub ambitions
topics.text: Armenia hosted the 56th meeting of the EAEU Joint Board of Customs Services, focusing on regional trade cooperation. Separately, a government minister stated Armenia aims to become a global AI hub, with a new National Center for Robotics and Physical AI launched and a technology college planned for Hrazdan by 2027.

topics.title: Armenian athletes compete internationally in weightlifting, chess, and football
topics.text: Three Armenian weightlifters will compete in a Doha qualifier for the LA2028 Olympics, while Haik Martirosyan defeated Arjun Erigaisi at the Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot 2026. In football, Ararat-Armenia defeated Van, and Eduard Spertsyan featured in a match for Al Ahli alongside Cristiano Ronaldo.
